                                   ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17, ofthe Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance be amended by changing all the Cl-2 Neighborhood Commercial District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 15-1 in the area bounded by

         West Thorndale Avenue; North Western Avenue; a line 273.71 feet south of and
         parallel to West Thorndale Avenue; the alley next west of and parallel to North
         Western Avenue

to those of C2-2 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District, and a corresponding use
district is hereby established in the area above described.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage
and due publication.



Common Address: 5832-5858 N. Western Avenue, 2401-2411 W. Thorndale Avenue
